stories.title: Prince William and Princess Kate to meet PM Modi in New Delhi
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales will conclude a three-day Mumbai visit with a meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi on Wednesday. The trip centers on the Prince’s Earthshot Prize ceremony. The schedule was adjusted Sunday following confirmation of the Prime Minister’s travel plans.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi claims India is no longer a democracy
stories.summary: Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi alleged at the Bharat Summit that India is no longer a democracy. He cited irregularities in voter rolls, claiming 7 million additional voters were added between recent elections. Gandhi accused the Union government of systematically weakening democratic institutions over the last decade.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav criticizes BJP development narrative
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav rejected the perception that recent police encounters in Uttar Pradesh signify improved law and order. Speaking at the HT Leadership Summit, Yadav accused the BJP of betraying citizens and failing to deliver on promises, proposing an alternative vision focused on social justice.

stories.title: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav discusses UP election seat sharing
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav stated his party has finalized its seat count for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. While the Congress has requested 181 of the 403 seats, Yadav declined to confirm any alliance with the Bahujan Samaj Party, asserting his coalition will win.

stories.title: India votes against UN death penalty moratorium
stories.summary: India voted against a UN General Assembly resolution calling for a moratorium on the death penalty. The government argued there is no international consensus against capital punishment, maintaining that every sovereign state holds the right to determine its own legal system and penalties for criminal offenses.

stories.title: Abhishek Banerjee questioned over remarks against BJP
stories.summary: Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee was questioned by Kolkata Police for four hours on Saturday. The summons followed a case registered in May regarding remarks Banerjee made about a Gujarati gang. Multiple FIRs have been lodged against the MP since the BJP assumed power in the state.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav clarifies Congress seat demand for UP polls
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav confirmed the Congress is seeking 181 of the 403 seats in the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. When asked if the request was for 200 seats, Yadav replied that the figure was slightly less, specifically adding one to 180.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi laughs as Italian leader echoes slogan
stories.summary: During an event in Hyderabad on Saturday, Giacomo Filibeck translated a slogan used by Rahul Gandhi. The incident prompted criticism from the BJP, which characterized the event as an attempt to defame India on a global platform.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi claims phone is being tapped
stories.summary: Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi alleged on Friday that Prime Minister Narendra Modi is tapping his phone. Gandhi claimed the device contains evidence supporting his allegations against the Prime Minister and renewed his challenge for a one-on-one debate to determine who is anti-national.

stories.title: Amit Shah accuses Rahul Gandhi of defaming India
stories.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah accused Rahul Gandhi of attempting to tarnish India’s image on global platforms. Shah’s comments followed Gandhi’s remarks at the Bharat Summit in Hyderabad, where the opposition leader claimed India was no longer a democracy. The minister addressed the matter in Pune.

stories.title: RSS chief warns against attempts to divide India
stories.summary: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat warned against efforts to divide India by exploiting smaller identities. Comparing the trend to British-era divide-and-rule policies, Bhagwat stated that certain global forces oppose India becoming a great nation. He called for national unity during a speech in Jodhpur.

stories.title: BJP calls for apology over Kishtwar killings remarks
stories.summary: BJP leader Sunil Sharma demanded an apology from Congress state chief Tariq Hameed Karra regarding the killing of two Special Police Officers in Kishtwar. Sharma accused the Congress of spreading misleading information that could fuel propaganda, after Karra suggested the officers might have been shot by security forces.

stories.title: Boy electrocuted by snapped wire in Malappuram
stories.summary: A 13-year-old boy died after touching a snapped stay wire in a paddy field on Sunday. Residents alleged that the Kerala State Electricity Board delayed disconnecting the power supply despite repeated calls. The incident triggered local protests, and the minister has ordered an official investigation.

stories.title: Madhya Pradesh CM announces aid for rain-deficit district
stories.summary: Chief Minister Mohan Yadav announced a crop loss survey for Alirajpur, the state’s worst rain-deficit district. Instructions were issued to the District Collector to provide financial assistance to affected farmers under the Revenue Book Circular. At least 11 districts in the state have experienced severe rainfall shortages.

stories.title: India reports increase in public health spending
stories.summary: The Union government’s health expenditure reached ₹4.14 lakh crore in 2023-24, up from ₹1.30 lakh crore a decade prior. According to National Health Accounts estimates, the share of out-of-pocket spending by households fell from 64.2% to 42.7% over the same period, reflecting a shift in healthcare financing.

stories.title: Accused in police shooting killed in encounter
stories.summary: Ratan Sheikh, a man accused of shooting a police constable in Santiniketan, was killed during a gunfight with police on Sunday. The incident occurred in Nanoor while officers were attempting an arrest. This marks the fifth police encounter in West Bengal since the BJP took office.

stories.title: PM Modi says tribals suffered under Maoist violence
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that tribal communities were denied voting rights and suffered under Maoist violence. Addressing a Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas programme, the Prime Minister accused previous governments of remaining silent spectators while Maoists abducted tribal women and children in affected areas.

stories.title: Eight injured in building collapse in Delhi
stories.summary: Eight people were injured when a portion of an under-construction building collapsed in Paharganj on Sunday evening. Victims were laying a roof for the second floor when the structure gave way. Delhi Police reported that all individuals were rescued within an hour and none are in critical condition.

stories.title: Delhi Police busts family-run heroin network
stories.summary: Delhi Police arrested six people and seized 2.25 kg of heroin worth ₹5 crore from a family-run trafficking network. The recovery included two Mahindra Thar SUVs, two motorcycles, a scooter, and five mobile phones. The operation followed a tip-off regarding transport on two-wheelers from Signature Bridge.

stories.title: Woman found murdered in Delhi showroom trial room
stories.summary: An 18-year-old woman was found dead with her throat slit inside a clothing showroom trial room in west Delhi on Saturday night. Staff discovered the body while closing the store near Moti Nagar Metro station. Police are investigating the involvement of a relative.

stories.title: President and PM pay tributes to Birsa Munda
stories.summary: President Droupadi Murmu and Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid floral tributes to tribal icon Birsa Munda at the Parliament House complex on his 151st birth anniversary. The occasion is also observed as Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas to honour the legacy of India's tribal communities.

stories.title: Four friends killed in car race crash
stories.summary: Four youths from Gauvapar village died after their speeding car crashed into a palm tree on the Nagra-Belthara Road in Uttar Pradesh. The group was racing another car late Saturday night when the driver lost control. Four other friends were also in the vehicles.

stories.title: Fire destroys 25 shops in Gurugram market
stories.summary: A fire at the woollens market in Gurugram's Pataudi town destroyed 25 shops on Sunday morning. Firefighters from Pataudi and Manesar brought the blaze under control. No injuries were reported, and the cause of the fire remains unknown.

stories.title: 26 killed in Assam truck-bus collision
stories.summary: A collision between a truck and a bus in Assam resulted in 26 deaths, including three girls from the same family. Cabinet Minister Atul Bora visited the families of the victims following the incident.

stories.title: Kadapa entrepreneur honoured at CII summit
stories.summary: Meghasyam Madineni, founder of deep-tech firm Quantivier, participated in the CII Partnership Summit after receiving the Start-up Leader of the Year award for 2026. His company focuses on enterprise systems and artificial intelligence, with a footprint spanning generative AI and machine learning sectors.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu investment panel targets $72 billion exports
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu Investment Promotion Commission met to discuss the New Industrial Policy 2027 and strategies to boost state exports. The commission is evaluating existing policies and reviewing progress on investment MoUs to reach its export target. Consultations with stakeholders have been ongoing since July 2026.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu engages developers for GCC corridors
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government held a roundtable with real estate developers to accelerate the development of Grade-A office space for Global Capability Centres. The initiative aims to support infrastructure across identified corridors to accommodate the state's growing ecosystem of multinational tech and business centres.

stories.title: BIM and Texas university launch AI business course
stories.summary: Bharathidasan Institute of Management and the University of Texas at Arlington announced a Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence for Business starting in August 2027. The programme targets working professionals with a tuition fee of $27,000. The first cohort will consist of 25 students.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan expected to hit Andhra coast
stories.summary: A depression in the Bay of Bengal is expected to strengthen into a severe cyclonic storm by November 17. Cyclone Akvan is forecast to move towards the Andhra Pradesh coast by November 19, bringing rainfall to Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, and the Karaikal area.

stories.title: Bay of Bengal depression to intensify
stories.summary: The India Meteorological Department expects a depression over the Bay of Bengal to become a severe cyclonic storm by November 17. The system is forecast to move north-northwestwards before heading toward the Andhra Pradesh coast over the following two days.

stories.title: Assam proposes flood plain zoning law
stories.summary: The Assam government plans to table the Flood Plain Zoning Bill 2026 during the winter assembly session. The legislation aims to restrict and regulate construction in flood-prone areas along the Brahmaputra and Barak river basins to mitigate risks from unregulated development.

stories.title: Air purifier sales rise amid pollution
stories.summary: Air purifier sales have surged across India following the post-Diwali deterioration of air quality in Delhi-NCR. Retailers report a shift in consumer behaviour, with demand increasingly moving from panic-driven seasonal purchases toward year-round adoption.

stories.title: Odisha braces for third cyclone
stories.summary: Odisha is preparing for a potential third cyclone in three weeks as a low-pressure area in the Bay of Bengal intensifies. The India Meteorological Department expects the system to become a cyclonic storm by Monday, though the specific landfall area remains unconfirmed.

stories.title: Gadkari suggests mine water for farming
stories.summary: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari suggested using water from MOIL and WCL mines to support agriculture in the drought-affected Vidarbha region. Speaking at the Agrovision exhibition, he encouraged farmers to adopt water conservation experiments to address local water shortages.

stories.title: Ethanol allocation from damaged grain triples
stories.summary: Oil marketing companies have tripled the allocation of ethanol produced from damaged foodgrains for the 2026-27 supply year. Maize allocation rose 8% as India reduces reliance on sugar-based feedstocks. Actual supply remains dependent on market prices and competition from other industries.

stories.title: KSSP warns against port-centric development
stories.summary: The Kerala Sasthra Sahithya Parishad has urged the government to reconsider Mission Samudra, warning that the project could threaten traditional fishing livelihoods and marine ecosystems. The group alleges the initiative facilitates corporate control over coastal resources through the development of 18 minor ports.

stories.title: Nearly 2,200 migrants reach Canary Islands in two days
stories.summary: Nearly 2,200 migrants reached the Canary Islands by boat over the past two days, according to Spain's maritime rescue service. The archipelago is a primary entry point for Atlantic crossings. Spain declared a migration emergency on November 11 following a recent rise in arrivals from West Africa.

stories.title: PM Modi and Trump to join ASEAN Summit in Manila
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will travel to Manila on November 16 for a three-day trip to attend the annual India-ASEAN Summit. The agenda includes maritime security and economic partnerships. US President Donald Trump and other world leaders are also expected to participate in the summit.

stories.title: Blinken says US went easy on Pakistan for years
stories.summary: Former US Secretary of State Antony Blinken said Washington’s need for help in Afghanistan previously made it less critical of Pakistan’s military. He stated at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit that the US no longer views India through a Pakistan lens. That approach is over and done.

stories.title: US views India as a global force, says Blinken
stories.summary: Antony Blinken stated at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit that the US views India as a global force for future technologies like AI and semiconductors. He contrasted this with the regional focus of US-Pakistan relations, noting that the de-hyphenation of the two relationships is now complete.

stories.title: Blinken calls India-US partnership essential
stories.summary: Former Secretary of State Antony Blinken described the India-US partnership as essential for the new century at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit. He noted that Washington should not expect New Delhi to follow its lead, acknowledging India’s long-standing strategic ties with Russia.

stories.title: Bahrain intercepts Iranian aerial attacks
stories.summary: Bahrain reported that its air defences destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks on Sunday. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed the strikes targeted a US military base in retaliation for hostile actions. The incident follows warnings for residents to seek shelter amid ongoing regional tensions.

stories.title: Putin demands nuclear concessions in peace deal
stories.summary: A Russian policy document dated November 10 outlines conditions for peace in Ukraine, including demands that Britain and France withdraw nuclear protection from European allies. Moscow also seeks the removal of NATO forces from Eastern Europe and the Baltic states, and the exclusion of Finland.

stories.title: UPS cargo plane clips Copa Airlines jet in Miami
stories.summary: A Copa Airlines flight was struck by a UPS cargo plane at a Miami airport taxiway intersection. Air traffic control audio indicates the UPS crew had been instructed to give way to the passenger jet. The incident occurred as the Copa flight taxied to its gate.

stories.title: Trump seeks trilateral summit with Xi and Putin
stories.summary: President Trump is proposing a meeting with the leaders of China and Russia on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen. The event would be the first trilateral summit between the three nuclear powers, potentially shifting focus from domestic political pressures and administrative divisions.

stories.title: Hindalco to sell Chinese aluminium units
stories.summary: Hindalco will sell its Novelis China aluminium operations to Shenzhen Hongzhi Industrial Investment Co. The divestment follows a trend of foreign manufacturers reassessing their exposure to China amid shifting global supply chains and increased domestic competition. The deal includes trading and production assets.

stories.title: Stiglitz warns of AI economic imbalances
stories.summary: Nobel laureate Joseph Stiglitz stated at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit that the AI boom creates challenges for global economic balance. He noted the lack of a macroeconomic model for AI and urged nations like India to increase education investments to mitigate potential employment impacts.

stories.title: Siddhartha Mukherjee on AI in drug discovery
stories.summary: Oncologist Siddhartha Mukherjee said at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit that AI is reducing drug design timelines from years to months. He argued that the technology must now make medicines faster, cheaper, and more accessible to patients to prove its value to the medical field.

stories.title: Mukherjee says medicine is the real test for AI
stories.summary: Oncologist Siddhartha Mukherjee stated at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit that AI will be judged by its ability to produce faster, cheaper, and better medicines. He warned that if the technology fails to achieve these outcomes, it will have failed the broader AI revolution.

stories.title: Dexcom CEO credits hard work for career path
stories.summary: Jake Leach, CEO of the $30 billion glucose-monitoring firm Dexcom, attributed his career success to hard work rather than a grand plan. Leach, who previously worked as a lab dishwasher, told Fortune that there are no shortcuts to reaching an executive leadership position.

stories.title: Petition to reinstate Jensen Huang gains traction
stories.summary: A campaign to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO has gathered 132,000 signatures, including support from Elon Musk. The petition, which organizers are vetting for fake entries, follows Huang's departure amid an affair scandal. The list reportedly includes thousands of current and former Nvidia employees.

stories.title: Lawmakers push for stricter AI chip export rules
stories.summary: US lawmakers are reportedly seeking tighter restrictions on advanced AI chip exports to China following the controversy surrounding former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The push comes as the company faces scrutiny regarding both its leadership and its international trade practices.

stories.title: Reports detail hostile workplace culture at Nvidia
stories.summary: Biographer Stephen Witt and other sources have described a tense environment under former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Accounts include instances of Huang yelling at executives and using harsh language. These reports contrast with the humble image Huang often projected by referencing his early work history.

stories.title: Denny’s reverses decision on Huang plaque
stories.summary: Denny’s has reinstated a plaque honoring former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who worked at the diner chain as a teenager. The restaurant had previously removed the tribute following Huang's recent departure from Nvidia. Huang has frequently cited his time as a dishwasher as a lesson in humility.

stories.title: Winter storm warning: Sierra Nevada faces 2 feet of snow, flooding threat in Texas
stories.summary: The NWS Weather Prediction Center has issued a warning for excessive rainfall across parts of southeastern Texas, citing potential thunderstorms and gusty winds. A separate weather system moving from the southern Rockies is expected to bring showers to the southern Plains and Gulf Coast. The storm continues moving offshore.

stories.title: Kashmiri wazwan feasts linked to rising diabetes cases
stories.summary: Experts say the traditional Kashmiri wazwan, which can reach 5,500 calories per sitting, is a key cultural factor in the region's diabetes spike. A new book notes that these multi-course feasts often contain over 30 meat preparations. The meals are now being examined for their cumulative health impact.

stories.title: Hyderabad hospital performs combined heart valve procedures in single sitting
stories.summary: Doctors at Apollo Hospitals performed Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation and Balloon Mitral Valvotomy on an 83-year-old patient in one session. The minimally invasive procedure was completed through the femoral artery. The patient had previously undergone coronary artery bypass surgery and pacemaker implantation.

stories.title: Medical camp provides services to 200 patients in Vijayawada
stories.summary: A health camp in Vijayawada provided consultations and medicine to 200 patients for a minimal fee. Organisers from Praja Arogya Vedika and Jana Vignana Vedika focused on diabetes, hypertension, and epilepsy. The group plans to hold similar camps every two months, with the next session scheduled for January 17.

stories.title: India reports rise in health spending as out-of-pocket costs fall
stories.summary: India's health expenditure reached 4.14 lakh crore in 2023-24, up from 1.30 lakh crore a decade ago. The share of out-of-pocket spending by households dropped to 42.7 percent from 64.2 percent in 2013-14. The government describes this shift as a significant transformation in the country's healthcare financing landscape.

stories.title: Cancer will not be cured in near future, says Siddhartha Mukherjee
stories.summary: Oncologist Siddhartha Mukherjee stated that while progress has been made, cancer will not be cured in the near future. Speaking at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit, he noted that certain intestinal and stomach cancers remain endemic in India. He also expressed concern regarding the rush toward AI in science.

stories.title: Experts warn against new anti-anaemia strategy
stories.summary: Public health experts are questioning the push for double-fortified salt to combat anaemia, citing limited evidence and the risk of ignoring other causes of iron deficiency. National anaemia prevalence data remains unpublished despite the survey concluding in November 2025. The government is currently shifting its focus toward salt.

stories.title: CMC holds diabetes awareness event for World Diabetes Day
stories.summary: The Christian Medical College held an awareness exhibition and poster competition to mark World Diabetes Day. The event focused on early diagnosis and holistic management. As part of the screening initiative, the hospital conducted blood glucose testing for more than 350 participants throughout the day.

stories.title: Experts advocate for advanced imaging in angioplasty
stories.summary: Cardiologists say advanced imaging techniques used during angioplasty can reduce the risk of cardiac complications and repeat procedures. The Society for Coronary Imaging and Physiology highlighted the need for wider adoption of these methods in India. Experts noted that successful angioplasty requires more than just opening a blockage.

stories.title: Animal Husbandry department to host antimicrobial resistance classes
stories.summary: The Animal Husbandry department is launching a series of classes for farmers and pharmacy students to address antimicrobial resistance. The initiative is part of the state's strategic action plan for World AMR Awareness Week. The campaign aims to raise public awareness regarding the health threats posed by resistance.

stories.title: AIIMS Delhi performs foetal surgery for spina bifida
stories.summary: Surgeons at AIIMS Delhi performed a six-hour procedure to treat myelomeningocele, a severe form of spina bifida. The surgery involved repairing an opening in the foetus's spine to prevent nerve damage. Doctors reported that both the mother and the foetus were stable and recovering well following the operation.

stories.title: Captain Shubhanshu Shukla sets 2040 goal for Indian moon landing
stories.summary: Captain Shubhanshu Shukla, the first Indian astronaut to visit the International Space Station, stated his mission is to see an Indian plant the Tricolour on the Moon by 2040. He credited the entire nation for his support during the 2025 Axiom Mission 4 space flight.

stories.title: Deep Ocean Mission vital for India, says MoES secretary
stories.summary: Ministry of Earth Sciences secretary Srinivasa Kumar Tumalla said the Deep Ocean Mission is essential for India's future. He addressed concerns regarding deep-sea mining, noting that exploratory surveys are currently taking place in the central Indian Ocean basin, far from the coast and local fishing communities.

stories.title: Girl climbs mobile tower in Uttar Pradesh to demand marriage
stories.summary: An 18-year-old girl climbed a mobile tower in Maharajganj district on Sunday, threatening to jump unless allowed to marry her boyfriend. Police reported that the girl's family opposed the relationship due to caste differences. The incident drew a large crowd to the village.

stories.title: Karnataka CM jokes about metro ticket costs
stories.summary: Karnataka Chief Minister D. K. Shivakumar joked that Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid for his ticket during a ride on Bengaluru's new Pink Line. Shivakumar suggested that politics should be kept separate from development projects. The Prime Minister has expressed support for the city's infrastructure growth.

stories.title: Uttar Pradesh man performs his own funeral rites while alive
stories.summary: A man in the Baraut tehsil area of Uttar Pradesh held a ceremony to perform his own funeral rites, known as Tehrvi. The event was intended to spare his daughter the burden of conducting the rituals after his death. The ceremony has drawn local attention.
